title: Numpad quick skills, warp (Numpad 7), heal / revive (Numpad .)
intro: Nobody possessed, no co-op. Main pawn selected in DPC (the one F6 would take). REFramework menu CLOSED during the steps. A dummy appears ahead.

steps.text: Open ground, camera facing where the dummy should go. Press End
Keep the dummy in the middle of the screen. Press Numpad 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 one at a time, about 3 s apart (wait for each skill).
Did each numpad key make him use that slot's skill on the dummy? Note any that didn't. Press End
Walk 15 m away from your pawns, then press Numpad 7 (warp pawns to you). Did they appear next to you? Press End
If a pawn is hurt or down, press Numpad . (heal / revive all). Did it work? Press End

probes.quick: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_quick.json"); return ok and d and (tostring(d.n) .. " " .. tostring(d.name) .. " -> " .. tostring(d.target) .. " " .. tostring(d.result))
probes.qn: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "DPC_quick.json"); return ok and d and d.n
probes.pskill: local pw = H.pawn(0); local h = pw and pw:call("get_Human"); return h and h:call("get_CustomSkillState")
probes.num: local s = "" for n = 1, 6 do if reframework:is_key_down(0x60 + n) then s = s .. n end end return s ~= "" and s or nil
